about: CI areas and cells. core.yml and targets.yml run scripts/ci/plan.py over this table and run each picked cell in the job of its group; core.yml runs base and conformance, targets.yml runs engines, runtimes and platforms (workflows): it sets up the cell's toolchains with .github/actions/setup, exports its vars as MATRIX_<KEY>, and runs its script. An area is chosen by its tools (tool: labels; a job may narrow them with its own tools) or, without labels, by main_paths on a push to main and pr_paths on a pull request (null: always). A cell runs on the platform of its runner unless its job names one. A job marked on_request runs only with ci:full; one marked push_only only on a push to main.
